THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Official logos

The yellow and green logo SVG files retain their authentic vector paths, shading and colors. Transparent yellow and green variants are available as SVG and PNG.

02

Template status

The web banner, app banner and Open Graph templates are proposed editable layouts featuring the official logo. Check current platform crops and final copy before release.

03

Transparent PNG and SVG downloads

The logo is available as supplied 2160 × 2160 PNG files and SVG vector masters. Choose PNG for raster workflows and SVG for scalable digital layouts. The same background and placement rules apply to both formats.

04

Transparent logo backgrounds

Yellow transparent: Brand Green #39823C only. Green transparent: Brand Gold #F3CB2D only. Never place on white, cream, black or arbitrary backgrounds.

05

Naming

Use skm-campaign-name-channel-locale-v01. Keep a clear version and locale for every creative.
